items.reason: Describes the same reference-equality comparison between Dayjs objects that prevents detection of zero-length day-off overrides.
Describes the same calculation of end from slotStartTime, allowing events to extend beyond working hours.
Describes the same early return for matching overrides that bypasses busy-time conflict checks.
Describes the same rejection of split-schedule slots when any working-hours interval excludes them.
Describes missing schedule arguments at the held-slot call site. This is distinct from the golden issues concerning how supplied overrides and working hours are evaluated.

Describes handling an undefined override timezone when calculating the offset. The golden timezone issues concern discarded date rollover and local-versus-UTC day comparisons; fixing those would not address this missing-timezone claim.
